ai-commit-fast.name: Lightweight commit (OpenCode)
ai-commit-fast.cmd: opencode run "/lightweight-commit" "Please create a lightweight commit for the currently staged changes" -m "opencode-go/minimax-m3" --agent build && opencode export $(opencode session list --max-count 1 --format json | jq -r '.[].id') | jq -r '.info as $i | .messages[-1].info as $m | "\($m.modelID) • \($m.providerID) • \((($i.time.updated-$i.time.created)/1000)|floor)s • \($m.tokens.total) tokens (\($m.tokens.input)i+\($m.tokens.output)o+\($m.tokens.reasoning)r, cache \($m.tokens.cache.read)r/\($m.tokens.cache.write)w) • $\( $m.cost )"'

ai-commit.name: Lightweight commit (OpenCode, choose model)
ai-commit.description: Run lightweight commit with OpenCode and pick model via placeholder
ai-commit.cmd: opencode run "/lightweight-commit" "Please create a lightweight commit for the currently staged changes" -m $(echo ${model} | cut -d: -f1) $(echo ${model} | grep -q ':' && echo --variant $(echo ${model} | cut -d: -f2)) --agent build && opencode export $(opencode session list --max-count 1 --format json | jq -r '.[].id') | jq -r '.info as $i | .messages[-1].info as $m | "\($m.modelID) • \($m.providerID) • \((($i.time.updated-$i.time.created)/1000)|floor)s • \($m.tokens.total) tokens (\($m.tokens.input)i+\($m.tokens.output)o+\($m.tokens.reasoning)r, cache \($m.tokens.cache.read)r/\($m.tokens.cache.write)w) • $\( $m.cost )"'

pi-commit-fast.name: Lightweight commit (Pi)
pi-commit-fast.cmd: pi -p --model "opencode-go/minimax-m3" "/skill:lightweight-commit Please create a lightweight commit for the currently staged changes" && f=$(ls -t "$HOME/.pi/agent/sessions/--$(pwd | sed 's|^/||;s|/|-|g')--"/*.jsonl | head -1) && jq -rs 'def n($x): $x // 0; ([.[] | select(.type=="message" and .message.role=="assistant")] | last) as $a | ([.[] | select(.type=="message") | .message.timestamp] | (max-min)/1000 | floor) as $s | ([.[] | select(.type=="message" and .message.role=="assistant") | .message.usage] | {i:(map(n(.input))|add),o:(map(n(.output))|add),r:(map(n(.reasoning))|add),cr:(map(n(.cacheRead))|add),cw:(map(n(.cacheWrite))|add),t:(map(n(.totalTokens))|add),c:(map(n(.cost.total))|add)}) as $u | "\($a.message.model) • \($a.message.provider) • \($s)s • \($u.t) tokens (\($u.i)i+\($u.o)o+\($u.r)r, cache \($u.cr)r/\($u.cw)w) • $\($u.c)"' "$f"

pi-commit.name: Lightweight commit (Pi, choose model)
pi-commit.description: Run lightweight commit with Pi and pick model via placeholder
pi-commit.cmd: pi -p --model "${model}" "/skill:lightweight-commit Please create a lightweight commit for the currently staged changes" && f=$(ls -t "$HOME/.pi/agent/sessions/--$(pwd | sed 's|^/||;s|/|-|g')--"/*.jsonl | head -1) && jq -rs 'def n($x): $x // 0; ([.[] | select(.type=="message" and .message.role=="assistant")] | last) as $a | ([.[] | select(.type=="message") | .message.timestamp] | (max-min)/1000 | floor) as $s | ([.[] | select(.type=="message" and .message.role=="assistant") | .message.usage] | {i:(map(n(.input))|add),o:(map(n(.output))|add),r:(map(n(.reasoning))|add),cr:(map(n(.cacheRead))|add),cw:(map(n(.cacheWrite))|add),t:(map(n(.totalTokens))|add),c:(map(n(.cost.total))|add)}) as $u | "\($a.message.model) • \($a.message.provider) • \($s)s • \($u.t) tokens (\($u.i)i+\($u.o)o+\($u.r)r, cache \($u.cr)r/\($u.cw)w) • $\($u.c)"' "$f"
